# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle with GREEN retries and learning loop |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | Language-specific pod for Python TDD execution via WorkerAgent and PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase using LLM prompts |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment using LLM |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer for containerized test runs |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Production ContainerRunner backed by rootless Podman |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, and persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to PostgreSQL or SQLite |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes and extracts learning insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Builds features incrementally using autonomous TDD |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Validates code against forbidden imports and builtins |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST signature maps for code context |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Drives TDD across multiple LanguagePods |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent.py | Generates TypeScript code for TDD phases |
| TypeScriptRunner | src/agents/typescript_runner.py | PodmanRunner variant for TypeScript harness |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Validates test quality before implementation |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Detects redundant tests before writing them |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures for self-improvement |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Tracks anonymous agent capabilities |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval for code generation |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³: Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator.py | Measures experiment success rates across the system |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |
| PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | src/reliability/playbook_analyzer.py | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN success |
| TDDCycleAnalyzer | src/reliability/tdd_cycle_analyzer.py | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement

    Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
    activate Cycle

    Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
    activate Pod
    Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
    Worker-->>Pod: test_code
    Pod->>ImportFilter: check(test_code)
    Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
    Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
    Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
    Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
    Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
    deactivate Pod

    alt RED aborted
        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(success=False)
    else RED passed
        loop max_green_attempts
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            Pod->>ImportFilter: check(impl_code)
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
            deactivate Pod
            break when green_result.passed or abort
            Note right of Cycle: error_feedback = green_result.output
        end

        alt GREEN passed
            Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            activate Pod
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
            deactivate Pod

            alt Learning enabled
                Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
            end
        end
    end

    Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
    Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
    deactivate Cycle

    Runner->>Runner: check if complete or max_iterations reached
```
